The declared consistency evidence compares class contracts only, so this divergence is invisible to it.

findings.remediation: Either inline every registered variant into canonical F0, or make canonical F0 delegate to VARIANT_REGISTRY.json as the single registry, and extend the consistency check to compare the variant sets.
